status: FROZEN 2026-10-21 (in-scope denominator 552); bounds provisional; classes advisory-only
statusNote: The in-scope denominator is frozen as the enumerated address-range list below; any re-segmentation is recorded as a denominator change in inScope.changes. Bounds come from the maintainer-revised static index (Macsbug-record splits, decoded dispatch tables; 918 ranges). They are still provisional: a 40-range sample (seed 20261021383) found 1 defect (2.5%), and about 3.6% of ranges start at fall-through fragments. Classes are the advisor's A-trap heuristics (new splits inherit the containing advisor range's class). An independent 40-routine re-class (seed 20261021378) measured 65% exact-class error and 37.5% render-relevance error (20% counting colour/port-state setters as render-relevant), above the 15% bar, so classes are advisory only: never cite them as decodes or use them to select the denominator. reachedFrom is static reference reachability (entry | pcRelative | relocated | jumpTable | fallThrough | unreached), not execution coverage; fallThrough means reached only by running off the end of a reached range with no terminator.
content: Start/end addresses (end exclusive), advisory class, reachability mechanism and in-scope flag only. No code bytes, instructions, trap lists or symbols.

inScope.rule: Unchanged from round 1 (unit = index range; kDEF0 + CDEFs: isData=false, reached, not CW runtime/data; PACH130: 19 DECISIONS-#3 cited ranges; static-unreached excluded). Two mechanical clarifications applied to the new index: (a) a range with no final terminator passes reachability to the range it falls into; (b) CW-runtime status = advisor runtime-lib OR a CW runtime Macsbug name in the range OR falling/straddling (switch table) into such a range.
inScope.sha256Rule: sha256 of the sorted (plain string sort) lines '<binary> <start> <end>', one per in-scope range, joined with \n, no trailing newline. scripts/report-coverage.mjs exits 1 on mismatch; a changed set is recorded in changes and re-pinned.

changes.what: First freeze (verification round 1) on the advisor's 801 ranges.
kDEF0 0x12dc0 re-admitted: reached through a window-kind jump table at 0x12da2 from 0x12d8c (confirmed from raw bytes, v2-lanes/L7/REVIEW.json round2); the first index called it unreached.

Re-segmentation (verification round 2): the maintainer-revised index splits ranges at Macsbug name records and decodes dispatch tables (801 -> 918 ranges). CDEF3 +26, kDEF0 -7, CDEF4 -5, PACH130 unchanged (26 added, 12 removed; the removed kDEF0/CDEF4 ranges are CodeWarrior exception/malloc runtime that the splits exposed). Same rule, plus two mechanical clarifications (see rule).

pending.what: The maintainer may merge or drop 10 in-scope ranges whose start is an internal fall-through label rather than a function start (kDEF0 0x192, 0x8d36, 0x95de, 0x960c, 0x97bc; CDEF3 0x7ee, 0x82a, 0x16ba, 0x1c1c, 0x2b96). That would give 542 and is recorded here as a change when it happens, not applied silently.

reachability: Every kDEF0 range that is not CodeWarrior runtime or data is statically reached (0x12dc0 included). The remaining unreached ranges in all binaries are CodeWarrior runtime or data and are out of scope.
